newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends up against dlr in spot, forwards.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends up against dlr in spot, forwards.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended at 35.685/695 to a dollar on Tuesday on poor demand for the U.S. currency, up from the opening level of 35.70/72 dealers said.
"Everyone expected them to come in and buy," said a dealer, referring to a large Calcutta bank whose buying and selling dictates the exchange rate. "But they didn't," he said.
"The market was generally long today," said a dealer, describing the closing rate as a technical correction.
Most of the day's deals were at 35.71/72 per dollar.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) made some "token" dollar purchases at 35.71 rupees to a dollar, dealers said.
